What the mesh offers the lens

The 0.5° lattice ray-casts the mesh from every frame's registered centre (5136 frames, 3.5 min). The mesh covers 100.0 % of the sphere at the median frame (100.0 % at the worst). Range per pitch band, sampled every 250 frames:

Criteria and the bar

A frame is good when every criterion is within tolerance (METRICS.md): coverage ≥ 0.85 of the lens region on a surface within the cap (10 m; far surfaces carry no label, "far-as-hole"), reliability ≥ 0.85 (surface seen from within 5–15 m of the walk), unsupported depth discontinuities ≤ 3 %, exposure ≤ 10 %, sharpness ≥ 0.6, person clearance ≥ 5.0°. A 30 s window (start every second) is planned by a dynamic programme over yaw (≤ 30.0 °/s) per pitch; 3 non-overlapping clips are chosen to maximise the number at the 90 % bar, then the good fractions minus the largest seen-surface overlap.
